text:
liam: folks — weekly FluxPay health check. Notable uptick in error surface this week, want to triage before EOW.
priya: saw the spike this morning, flagged to renewals as potential risk.
alex: quick snapshot from our logs: overall 5xx rate across FluxPay org went 1.1% -> 3.6% week-over-week. Timeouts up 2.4pp.
sam: ouch. any single points of failure?
alex: top failing endpoints by error count (last 7d):
```
1) POST /v1/generate      — 4,200 errors (65% 5xx, 25% timeouts, 10% rate_limited)
2) POST /v1/embeddings    — 1,100 errors (50% timeouts, 40% 5xx, 10% rate_limited)
3) POST /v1/chat/stream   —   800 errors (70% timeouts, 20% 5xx, 10% client)
4) GET  /v1/status/model  —   320 errors (90% 5xx)
5) POST /v1/batch/score   —   210 errors (60% rate_limited, 30% timeouts)
```
liam: most obvious is /v1/generate. Error spikes line up with mid-day traffic window and a lot of long context usage.
emily: noted that FluxPay recently increased max_tokens in their SDK — could be KV cache churn + longer seq -> timeouts.
priya: customer onboarding notes: they increased batch sizes after enablement session last week. I'll loop them in.
ops-bot: automated alert: spike detected on route /v1/generate at 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z — throttle policy applied to Tier:standard.
alex: initial hypotheses:
- large payloads + no prefix caching -> longer runtimes + request queueing -> timeouts/5xx
- misconfigured client retry behavior amplifying rate limits
- model variant fallback not enabled so heavy model triggers 5xx under load

sam: plan proposal:
1) Alex to pull detailed traces for /v1/generate (p95 latency breakdown, KV cache hit rate) — due: 2026-03-11 12:00 PT @alex
2) Priya to schedule 30m sync with FluxPay to advise on batching and token limits, include enablement doc link — due: 2026-03-12 @priya
3) Ops to temporarily raise burst capacity on Dedicated pool for FluxPay (if on dedicated) or enable lower-cost fallback model routing for heavy requests — due: 2026-03-11 by infra team
4) Sam to review client SDK telemetry for retry storms and suggest client-side jitter/backoff defaults — due: 2026-03-12 @sam

priya: adding a renewal note: increase in visible errors + customer reported degraded UX. If we can't show remediation within 7 days, flag as "elevated risk" for renewals.
liam: agreed. Alex, prioritize traces and produce a short playbook (1 pager) we can share in the sync.
alex: on it — will attach logs excerpt to this thread when ready.
priya: I'll draft meeting invite and include sample config tweaks (reduce max_tokens to 2/3 of current, enable prefix caching).
emily: small suggestion — send a repro script to FluxPay so they can replicate locally with reduced tokens before the call.
liam: thanks team. If anyone finds an immediate blocker (e.g., config that we can flip server-side), ping here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: incident-notify channel also copied this thread for cross-team visibility.
